components.css: .ds-root{--paper:#fbfcf7;--band:#e4f0da;--rule:#c9ddbb;--ink:#161b26;--ink-2:#3f4756;--ink-3:#5b6472;--blue:#1f4aa8;--red:#b3261e;--amber:#7a4f00;font-family:'Public Sans Variable',system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink)} .ds-btn{min-height:44px;padding:0 16px;background:transparent;color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--ink-3);border-radius:3px;font:600 15px 'Public Sans Variable',system-ui,sans-serif;transition:background-color 120ms ease-out,border-color 120ms ease-out;cursor:pointer} .ds-btn:hover{background:var(--band);border-color:var(--ink)} .ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue);outline-offset:2px} .ds-btn:active{background:var(--rule)} .ds-primary{background:var(--blue);color:#fff;border-color:var(--blue)} .ds-primary:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--blue) 88%,var(--ink));border-color:var(--blue)} .ds-danger{color:var(--red);border-color:var(--red)} .ds-danger:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--red) 12%,var(--paper));border-color:var(--red)}

components.css: .ds-root{--paper:#fbfcf7;--band:#e4f0da;--rule:#c9ddbb;--ink:#161b26;--ink-2:#3f4756;--ink-3:#5b6472;--blue:#1f4aa8;--red:#b3261e;--amber:#7a4f00;font-family:'Public Sans Variable',system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink)} .ds-stamp{display:inline-flex;padding:0 6px;border:1.5px solid currentColor;border-radius:2px;font:700 12px/1.35 'JetBrains Mono Variable',ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;transform:rotate(-1.5deg)} .ds-approved{color:var(--blue)} .ds-void{color:var(--red)} .ds-awaiting{color:var(--amber)} .ds-sign{font-size:14px;padding:1px 8px;outline:1px solid currentColor;outline-offset:2px} .ds-listing{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;border-top:1px solid var(--ink)} .ds-listing>li{border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule)} .ds-listing>li:nth-child(even){background:var(--band)} .ds-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:4.5rem 8rem 1fr 9rem;align-items:stretch} .ds-row>span{padding:13px 0 10px 14px;border-left:1px solid var(--rule)} .ds-row>span:first-child{border-left:0;padding-left:16px} .ds-t{font:12px 'JetBrains Mono Variable',ui-monospace,monospace;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--ink-3)} .ds-a{font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--ink-2)} .ds-c{line-height:1.55} .ds-struck{text-decoration:line-through;text-decoration-color:var(--red);text-decoration-thickness:1px;color:var(--ink-3)} .ds-m{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:4px} .ds-bar{display:block;width:100%;height:4px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink) 16%,var(--band));border-radius:1px;overflow:hidden} .ds-bar>i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--ink-2);transform:scaleX(var(--s,0));transform-origin:left}

components.css: .ds-root{--paper:#fbfcf7;--band:#e4f0da;--rule:#c9ddbb;--ink:#161b26;--ink-2:#3f4756;--ink-3:#5b6472;--blue:#1f4aa8;--red:#b3261e;--amber:#7a4f00;font-family:'Public Sans Variable',system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink)} .ds-live{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:10px 16px;border-top:1px solid var(--ink);border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule)} .ds-cursor{display:inline-block;width:.5em;height:1em;margin-left:.25em;background:var(--blue);animation:ds-blink 1s steps(2,start) infinite} @keyframes ds-blink{to{visibility:hidden}} .ds-bar{display:block;width:56px;height:4px;background:var(--rule);border-radius:1px;overflow:hidden;flex:none} .ds-bar>i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--blue);transform:scaleX(var(--s,0));transform-origin:left;transition:transform 220ms linear}

components.css: .ds-root{--paper:#fbfcf7;--band:#e4f0da;--rule:#c9ddbb;--ink:#161b26;--ink-2:#3f4756;--ink-3:#5b6472;--blue:#1f4aa8;--red:#b3261e;--amber:#7a4f00;font-family:'Public Sans Variable',system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink)} .ds-tabs{display:grid;grid-auto-flow:column;grid-auto-columns:1fr;background:var(--paper);border-top:1px solid var(--ink)} .ds-tabs a{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;min-height:60px;color:var(--ink-3);font:500 12px 'Public Sans Variable',system-ui,sans-serif;text-decoration:none} .ds-tabs a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue);outline-offset:-2px} .ds-tabs a[aria-current=page]{color:var(--ink);font-weight:700;background:var(--band)} .ds-tabs a[aria-current=page]::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0 0 auto 0;height:2px;background:var(--blue)} .ds-badge{min-width:18px;height:18px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border:1.5px solid var(--amber);color:var(--amber);border-radius:2px;font:700 11px/1 'JetBrains Mono Variable',ui-monospace,monospace}

narrative.overview: The agent's work is printed, not chatted. Every step of a run is a ruled line on banded greenbar fanfold paper, and nothing is ever deleted: a rejected, expired or failed line stays in place, struck through and rubber-stamped. Human decisions are signed in ribbon blue; voids and failures in ribbon red; amber appears only for what is still waiting. The dark theme is the same listing on a phosphor terminal.
keyCharacteristics: Greenbar banding with a heavy ink top rule and hairline green rules under each line.
Stamps as the only state vocabulary: outlined mono chips, always carrying a word.
Live print-head row: blinking block cursor plus a duration bar that grows to scale.
Sans for everything read; mono only for time, milliseconds, cost, stamps.
Light and phosphor-dark themes from one token set.

rules.name: The Ribbon Rule
rules.body: Blue means a human did it or is acting; red means void or failed; amber means still waiting. A colour never carries a state alone; the stamp word is always present.

rules.name: The Green Is Paper Rule
rules.body: Green belongs to the paper (band, rule, scrim ink), never to a status. There is no success green.

rules.name: The Mono Ration Rule
rules.body: Monospace is for time, milliseconds, cost and stamps. Anything a person reads as a sentence is sans.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number that lines up in a column uses tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Ruled Column Rule
rules.body: Wide listings separate columns with 1px hairline rules, not gaps or cards.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats except the single desktop popover sheet. Cards, glows and stacked shadows do not exist here.

dos: Do print every state as a line and mark it with a stamp that carries its word.
Do keep banding, the heavy ink top rule and hairline dividers on any new list.
Do use Ribbon Blue only for human action and focus, red for void/failed, amber for waiting.
Do keep mono to time, ms, cost, tokens and stamps.
Do keep controls at 44px and corners at 2-3px.
Do animate only as printing: line-feed reveal 180ms, stamp-down 160ms, cursor blink, bar growth; honour reduced motion.
donts: Don't add cards, rounded pills, gradients or glow shadows; the world is flat paper.
Don't add a success green or use colour alone to signal state.
Don't delete a rejected or failed line; strike and stamp it.
Don't reintroduce the sidebar-plus-bubbles chat pattern.
